next.reason: 1985: 'The availability of the file description entry for a report file is dependent on whether the Report Writer module is supported'; 2023: 'Format 3 is the file description entry for a report file. No record description entries or constant entries shall be associated'. Both make Format 3 the report-file FD, but 2023 states it unconditionally, without the 1985 dependency on support of the Report Writer module.
